title: Prepare a commercial electric griddle: brace handle, insert probe, turn dial on, and place bread
instruction: Brace the electric griddle by its handle to seat the heat control probe, turn the dial on, and place both slices of bread on its cooking surface.
context: Short-order cooks and food service workers (SOC 35-2015, 35-2014) prepare griddle surfaces for meal cooking. Pushing the detachable heat control probe into the 1.19 kg griddle slides the unbraced pan across the counter, requiring bimanual coordination to brace the griddle handle while seating the probe, turning the temperature dial into its active range, and placing bread slices on the cooking area.
setup: Kitchen bench: Presto 07211 electric griddle (1.19 kg, 21.6x26.7 cm cooking plate) centred at (0.35,-0.11,TOP+0.055); detachable 105 g Control Master probe with 44 mm dial at (0.148,-0.150,TOP+0.041) in guide cradle; serving plate with two 35 g bread slices at (0.165,0.110) and (0.165,0.190); wall outlet at (0.52,-0.43,TOP+0.085).
scoring: 0.0 if item dropped, food placed before probe, or griddle tipped. Partial: 0.25 when probe seated home; 0.50 when probe seated and dial turned >=15 deg ON; 0.75 when probe seated, dial ON, 1 bread placed; 1.0 when probe seated, dial ON, both bread placed flat, and arms clear >=20 mm.
reset_notes: Turn dial to OFF (0 deg), unseat probe and place in cradle, place bread slices on plate.
fidelity: Rigid bodies in Isaac Lab-Arena PhysX. Griddle, probe, plate, and bread models at true scale and mass. Receptacle shroud encloses probe nose; rotary dial has calibrated viscous and Coulomb friction.
